title: Working Women Hostel Safety Inspection Checklist
title_te: ఉద్యోగ మహిళల హాస్టల్ భద్రతా తనిఖీ చెక్‌లిస్ట్
problem: Older girls moving to town for work struggle to check if private hostel rooms have safe doors and working window latches.
idea: A pocket safety checklist. Akka ticks each point while visiting a hostel and the page tells her if it looks safe or if she should look for another place.

widgets.heading: ✅ Hostel Room Safety Check
widgets.intro: Tick only what you saw working with your own eyes.

items.text: Room door has a strong lock from inside
items.te: గది తలుపుకు లోపల నుండి బలమైన తాళం ఉంది

items.text: Lights work in corridors and stairs
A lady warden stays at the hostel
Fire extinguisher and a clear exit
items.te: అగ్నిమాపక పరికరం, బయటకు వెళ్ళే దారి ఉన్నాయి

items.text: Clean bathroom with a working door lock
Hostel gives a written receipt for rent

bands.text: This hostel looks safe. Share the address with your family.
Some things are missing. Ask the owner to fix them before you join.
Not safe enough. Look for another hostel.

items.title: Visit with family
items.text: Visit the hostel first with a parent or relative, in daytime.
items.te: మొదట పగలు, కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో హాస్టల్ చూడండి.

items.title: Talk to girls there
items.text: Ask girls already staying there how they feel.

items.title: Share location
items.text: Send the hostel address and owner's number to home.
items.te: హాస్టల్ చిరునామా, యజమాని నంబర్ ఇంటికి పంపండి.

items.title: Save helplines
items.text: Save 100/112 (police) and 181 (women helpline) in your phone.

how: Ask Gemini to list safety points a girl should check in a working women's hostel.
Discuss the list with my mother and an older sister to add their ideas.
Open Canva and choose a small 'pocket card' or bookmark size template.
Add tick boxes, icons and Telugu-English text.
Print and give the cards to older girls moving to town for jobs.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Make a checklist of 10 short safety points for a young woman checking a private working women's hostel in a town (doors, windows, warden, lights, fire safety). Write each point in simple English and simple Telugu.
